methodologyNotes: Pricing re-verified 2026-06-15 by fetching each vendor's official pricing page via WebFetch (glossgenius.com/pricing, mangomint.com/pricing, joinblvd.com/pricing, biz.booksy.com/en-us/pricing, squareup.com/us/en/appointments/pricing, fresha.com/pricing, vagaro.com/pro/pricing, phorest.com/pricing, zenoti.com/pricing). GlossGenius, Mangomint, Boulevard, Booksy: exact monthly prices confirmed directly on the official pages. Square Appointments: official page renders prices via dynamic placeholders not present in HTML, so Free $0 / Plus $29 / Premium $69 per location were corroborated via schedulingkit.com (live, verified 2026-04-25); one competing source (koalendar) cites $49/$149, treated as an older tier. Vagaro: official US pricing page geo-redirects to a UK version with no USD figures, so $30 base / $10 per additional calendar / $90 cap were corroborated via koalendar.com and glossgenius.com/blog (both live). Fresha: official page serves EUR (€12.95 Individual, €8.95/member Team) and US-localised USD prices could NOT be confirmed on the official page; $19.95 / $14.95 are widely reported by third-party aggregators (costbench, schedulingkit, pabau) but every one explicitly flags them as 'approximately' / 'unverified against fresha.com/pricing' — treated as third-party estimates, provenance downgraded. Quote-only vendors (Phorest, Zenoti) confirmed to publish NO prices on their pricing pages; all plans monthlyUsd null. Boulevard prices reflect a current new-customer promo (standard rates noted). Schedulicity was acquired by Vagaro (Jan 2025) and its domain redirects to Vagaro; not listed. accessedAt 2026-06-15.

vendors.name: Vagaro
vendors.provenance: Official US pricing page (vagaro.com/pro/pricing) geo-redirected to the UK version and returned no USD figures (only a HIPAA Compliance badge). $30/month base for 1 calendar, $10 per additional calendar (up to the 7th), and the $90/month cap were corroborated from two live third-party reviews (koalendar.com/blog/vagaro-pricing and glossgenius.com/blog/vagaro-cost), both of which agree on the structure. A current promo of $24/mo for the base calendar is noted on those sources but the standard $30 is used. HIPAA badge appears on the official page.

plans.name: 1 Calendar
plans.notes: 1 bookable staff calendar. Online booking, client marketplace, 1,000 free monthly emails, appointment reminders, loyalty programs, 24/7 support. Each additional calendar (up to 7th) adds $10/month; calendars 8+ are free. Promo of $24/mo sometimes offered. Price corroborated via third-party reviews; official US page redirects to UK with no USD shown.

plans.name: 2 Calendars
plans.notes: Base $30 + $10 for 2nd calendar. Same features as 1-calendar plan. Derived from per-calendar structure corroborated by third-party reviews.

plans.name: 7+ Calendars
plans.notes: Base $30 + $10 x 6 additional calendars = $90/month cap. Calendars 8 and beyond are included at no extra charge. Pricing caps at 7 paid calendars. Cap corroborated by koalendar and glossgenius reviews.

limits: USD pricing not displayed on official page (US page redirects to UK)
keyFeatures: Per-calendar pricing scales with team size (cap at 7 paid)
Built-in marketplace for client discovery
HIPAA-compliant SOAP notes for wellness providers
Comprehensive add-on ecosystem (payroll, website builder, check-in app)
enrichment.provenance: USD prices corroborated from two live independent reviews. Official US pricing page redirects to UK and shows no USD figures; HIPAA badge confirmed on official page.

vendors.name: Fresha
vendors.provenance: Official page (fresha.com/pricing) served EUR (€12.95 Individual, €8.95/member Team) and did NOT display USD prices. USD figures ($19.95 Individual, $14.95/member Team) are widely reported by third-party aggregators (costbench.com, schedulingkit.com, pabau.com) but EVERY source flags them as 'approximately' / 'unverified against fresha.com/pricing' — they could not be confirmed on the official page. costbench.com does not actually cite fresha.com/pricing (its stated source is Reddit discussions), contradicting the draft's claim. Processing fees on the live page are 1.29% + €0.20 (not the 2.29%/2.79% + $0.20 in the draft). Compliance (HIPAA listed as available, ISO 27001, GDPR) confirmed on the official page. Treat USD prices as third-party estimates.

plans.name: Independent
plans.notes: Single-calendar solo plan. 20 free messages and 50 free marketing emails/month. 7-day free trial, no card required. USD price ($19.95) is a third-party estimate; official page serves EUR (€12.95) and does not display USD. Marketplace fee applies to brand-new clients only.

plans.name: Team
plans.notes: Priced per bookable team member per month. 20 free messages and 50 free marketing emails per team member/month. Phone, chat, and email support. 7-day free trial. Enterprise plan available for 20+ team members (custom pricing). USD price ($14.95/member) is a third-party estimate; official page shows €8.95/member.

limits: Marketplace commission applies to brand-new clients only (no fee for returning clients)
Enterprise tier requires custom quote for 20+ members
USD prices not shown on official page (serves EUR); USD is third-party estimate
keyFeatures: Per-seat Team plan scales cheaply for multi-staff locations
Built-in consumer marketplace for new client discovery
HIPAA (listed as available), ISO 27001 certified, GDPR compliant
Optional add-ons: Loyalty, Insights, Xero sync
enrichment.provenance: USD prices are third-party estimates (schedulingkit, pabau) explicitly flagged unverified against the official page, which serves EUR. Compliance confirmed on official page. Fresha moved from fully free to paid subscriptions in 2025.

vendors.name: Booksy
vendors.provenance: Pricing confirmed directly on the official page (biz.booksy.com/en-us/pricing): $29.99/month base, $20/month per additional staff member, 14-day free trial (no card), 2,000 free SMS marketing messages/month. No HIPAA statement anywhere on the page.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: All features included. Additional team members $20/month each. 2,000 free SMS marketing messages/month (appointment confirmations and reminders always free). Unlimited bookings, client management, email and text marketing, gift cards, memberships, reporting. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

limits: Boost marketing tool charges commission on first-time client visit
keyFeatures: Single all-inclusive plan with no feature gating
Boost marketplace for new client acquisition (commission on first visit)
2,000 free SMS/month included
Reserve with Google integration for bookings
enrichment.provenance: Pricing confirmed directly from biz.booksy.com/en-us/pricing official page. No HIPAA stated.

vendors.name: GlossGenius
vendors.provenance: All pricing confirmed directly on glossgenius.com/pricing: Standard $28/mo ($24/mo annual, ~14% off), Gold $56/mo ($48/mo annual, ~14% off), Platinum $168/mo ($148/mo annual, ~12% off). 2-week free trial, no card. HIPAA appears only as a feature within Forms & Waivers / EMR (med-spa add-on), not a vendor-wide certification — hipaa flagged true with that caveat. No forever-free plan.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Custom booking website, unlimited client notifications, email and text marketing, inventory management, packages and memberships. Annual billing: $24/month. 14-day free trial, no credit card required.

plans.name: Gold
plans.notes: All Standard features plus forms and waivers, Google booking integration, automated waitlist, time tracking, room and resource management. Annual billing: $48/month. Most popular plan.

plans.name: Platinum
plans.notes: All Gold features plus team goal setting, advanced analytics, customizable commissions, Google Marketing Analytics integration. Annual billing: $148/month. Add-on: Payroll $40/mo + $6/staff member.

limits: Single flat payment processing rate 2.6% on all transactions
HIPAA charting requires Forms & Waivers / EMR add-on (not a vendor-wide certification)
keyFeatures: Flat 2.6% processing rate with no surcharges for Tap to Pay or card-on-file
Free same-day payouts Mon-Thu; instant payouts at +1.8%
HIPAA-compliant forms/EMR add-on for medical spas
AI-powered tools included across all plans
enrichment.provenance: All pricing confirmed directly from glossgenius.com/pricing. HIPAA is tied to the Forms & Waivers/EMR add-on, not a blanket certification.

vendors.name: Square Appointments
vendors.provenance: Plan structure (Free / Plus / Premium / Square Pro custom) confirmed on the official page; dynamic price placeholders were not rendered in HTML. Free $0 (forever-free, solo/single-location), Plus $29/mo per location, Premium $69/mo per location corroborated via schedulingkit.com (live, verified 2026-04-25) which cites the official page. A competing source (koalendar) reports $49/$149, treated as an older/different tier; the $29/$69 figure is corroborated by 2026 sources and used here. Free plan is genuinely perpetual.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Forever-free for solo professionals. Online booking site, appointment reminders, unlimited appointments, payment processing (2.6% + $0.10 in-person). Single location, single staff member. No multi-staff booking or waitlist.

plans.name: Plus
plans.notes: Per location per month. Multi-staff appointment booking, cancellation policy and no-show fees, waitlist. Free trial available. Price corroborated via schedulingkit.com citing the live Square page.

plans.name: Premium
plans.notes: Per location per month. All Plus features plus resource management, service cost tracking, future bookings report. Designed for large salons with complex staff management. Free trial available. Price corroborated via schedulingkit.com.

limits: Free plan limited to single location / single staff member
Square Pro (>$250k/yr volume) requires custom pricing
keyFeatures: Genuinely forever-free tier for solo professionals
Native integration with full Square ecosystem (POS, Payroll, Marketing)
Resource management on Premium tier
No-show fee enforcement on Plus and Premium
bestFor: small salons already on Square POS
enrichment.provenance: Free $0 forever-free confirmed. Plus $29 and Premium $69 per location corroborated from schedulingkit.com (live, 2026-04-25) citing the official Square page; official page renders prices via dynamic placeholders. koalendar's $49/$149 treated as an older tier.

vendors.name: Mangomint
vendors.provenance: All pricing confirmed directly on mangomint.com/pricing: Essentials $165/mo (2-10 providers, +$95/location), Standard $245/mo (up to 20 providers, +$135/location), Unlimited $375/mo (unlimited providers, +$175/location). HIPAA compliance available across all plans with BAA upon request (confirmed on page). No forever-free plan; free trial available.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: 2-10 service providers. Calendar and scheduling, client management, online booking, retail and inventory, gift cards, mobile apps, reporting, multi-location support, POS payments. Additional locations: $95/month each.

plans.name: Standard
plans.notes: Up to 20 service providers. All Essentials features plus Express Booking, Virtual Waiting Room, Memberships and Packages, Mailchimp integration. Additional locations: $135/month each. Add-ons: Forms $50/mo, Connect (call/text/chat) $75/mo.

plans.name: Unlimited
plans.notes: Unlimited service providers. All Standard features plus Shopify integration, advanced webhooks. Additional locations: $175/month each. In-person processing: 2.45% + $0.15; virtual: 2.90% + $0.30.

limits: Shopify only on Unlimited plan (or add-on)
keyFeatures: HIPAA-compliant with BAA available upon request on all tiers
Express Booking and Virtual Waiting Room on Standard+
No contracts, cancel anytime
Free data import and 1:1 onboarding on all plans
enrichment.provenance: All pricing and compliance data confirmed directly from mangomint.com/pricing official page. BAA available upon request.

vendors.name: Boulevard
vendors.provenance: Pricing confirmed directly on joinblvd.com/pricing: Essentials $140/mo (normally $176), Premier $234/mo (normally $293), Prestige $328/mo (normally $410) — all per location, reflecting a new-customer 10% promo. Enterprise is custom (monthlyUsd null). Page states PCI / HIPAA / SOC compliance (references Data Security page). No free trial duration listed.

plans.name: Essentials
plans.notes: Per location per month (new-customer promo; standard rate $176/mo). Up to 5 professionals, 100 free texts/mo, 500 free email blasts/mo, 25 GB storage. Save 10% with annual billing.

plans.name: Premier
plans.notes: Per location per month (promo; standard rate $293/mo). Unlimited professionals, 250 free texts/mo, 1,000 free email blasts/mo, 50 GB storage. Save 10% annually.

plans.name: Prestige
plans.notes: Per location per month (promo; standard rate $410/mo). All Premier features plus Forms add-on included, 2,500 free texts/mo, 10,000 free email blasts/mo, 100 GB storage. Save 10% annually.

plans.name: Enterprise
plans.notes: Bespoke plan for large self-care businesses with multiple locations. Custom pricing via sales consultation.

limits: Forms add-on included only on Prestige
QuickBooks integration is a paid add-on
Texts and emails beyond free allocation billed per-use
Promo pricing for new customers only (standard rates higher)
keyFeatures: PCI, HIPAA, and SOC compliant
Built-in text and email marketing with generous free allowances
Hospitality integration (OPERA PMS) for resort spas
AI-powered booking via REACH.ai integration
enrichment.provenance: Prices confirmed from joinblvd.com/pricing (new-customer promo noted on page). PCI/HIPAA/SOC compliance referenced on the same page.

vendors.name: Phorest
vendors.provenance: phorest.com/pricing confirmed plan tier names (Starter, Grow, Ultimate, Elite plus Core/Elevate/Elite Aesthetics med-spa variants) with NO published prices — all quote-only (Request a quote). No HIPAA or compliance certifications on the page; only general encryption/cloud-storage language.

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Quote only. Entry-level plan for salons and spas. Unlimited devices, unlimited staff. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: Grow
plans.notes: Quote only. Most popular plan. Advanced marketing and retention tools. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: Ultimate
plans.notes: Quote only. Full feature set for growing salon groups. Contact sales for pricing.

plans.name: Elite
plans.notes: Quote only. Premium tier with bespoke features for salon groups and chains. Contact sales for pricing.

limits: All pricing is quote-only — no self-serve signup
No HIPAA or compliance certifications published
keyFeatures: Starter-to-Elite progression tailored to salon growth stage
Med spa variants (Core/Elevate/Elite Aesthetics) available
Unlimited staff and devices on all plans
Built-in client retention and marketing tools
enrichment.provenance: Plan names confirmed from phorest.com/pricing. No prices published; all quote-only confirmed on official page.

vendors.name: Zenoti
vendors.provenance: zenoti.com/pricing confirmed NO published pricing — fully custom/quote based ('Multi-location pricing is customized based on your footprint and needs'). Package names: Zenoti OS, AI Workforce/AI Plus. All CTAs are Get a Quote / Book a Demo.

plans.name: Zenoti OS
plans.notes: Core operations platform covering appointment booking, payroll, inventory, POS, and reporting. Enterprise/multi-location pricing customised per footprint. Annual contracts typical. Contact sales for quote.

plans.name: AI Plus
plans.notes: Add-on AI agent suite (AI Workforce) layered on top of Zenoti OS. Requires AI Plus package. Pricing quote only.

limits: No published pricing — enterprise sales process required
Implementation/setup fees reported by third parties
keyFeatures: Purpose-built for enterprise chains and franchise spa/salon groups
AI agent workforce add-on for automated bookings and upsells
Consolidates multiple software subscriptions
Multi-location pricing customised per footprint
